description: Owner only: needs the office access code (bo_live_...) as Bearer; a bot link (bi_...) does not get this tool. Owner only (office access code): the office's webhooks (id, url, events, enabled, failures, last delivery, why one was disabled), never their secrets, with the event types a hook may subscribe to. Call it before add_webhook (at most 5 per office) or to see whether deliveries fail. Same as GET /v1/workspaces/:id/webhooks. Example: {} (no arguments).
name: list_webhooks
title: List webhooks
